findings.description: The async OR implementation flattens a left-hand retry_all, changing its AND conditions into OR conditions. This check should recognize retry_any instead.
findings.rationale: For async predicates in (a & b) | (c | d), with a returning true and b, c, and d returning false, this branch constructs retry_any(a, b, c, d). The expression consequently returns true instead of false, causing retries when the configured conditions reject them.
